events.description: 40. ORDER ACKNOWLEDGING MOTION TO TRANSFER - This Court recognizes why Defendants have now filed a motion to transfer with this Court, given that some caselaw from the Southern District of Florida suggests that the transferring court is the appropriate court to rule on such motions. However, consistent with this Court's prior decisions, see, e.g., Humbert v. Bytedance, Inc., Case No.: 5:24cv236-MW/MJF, 2025 WL 2412155 (N.D. Fla. Jan. 28, 2025) (Walker, C.J.) (order denying motion to transfer without prejudice), this Court defers to the Southern District of Florida with respect to its decision on a motion to transfer now pending in the first-filed case. Signed by JUDGE MARK E WALKER on 4/20/26. (sjb) (Entered: 04/20/2026)
